newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE'S MUGABE RETURNS HOME FROM JAMAICA VISIT.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE'S MUGABE RETURNS HOME FROM JAMAICA VISIT.

text.p: Zimbabwean President Robert Mugabe returned home on Monday from a four-day state visit to Jamaica, which he said was aimed at boosting political and trade ties.

Mugabe was accompanied by his wife Grace, four government ministers and several state officials to the Carribbean island where he visited the capital Kingston and two resort towns of Negril and Montego Bay.

Zimbabwe and Jamaica established diplomatic ties in 1980 and trade between the two countries was valued at just over Z$400,000 in 1995 when the southern African state imported alcohol worth Z$334,000 and Jamaica bought furniture worth Z$80,000.
